title: 第16章 文化与宣传2第17章 文化宣传3
slug: 领主反派破灭后开始当战犯
content_zh:
我叫达尼娅.卡柏林，出生在西境的一处骑士家中，我从记事起，就是跟着父亲四处冒险。
说是冒险，其实是为了找妈妈和姐姐。
我从来没有见过妈妈和姐姐。
不知道他们是怎么样的。
爸爸只是个d级冒险者，不过他还是个商人。
我们四处冒险的过程中，父亲总会注意物价，购买一些物资，然后去到卖的贵的地方卖。
我也从爸爸那里学会了商人的知识。
在我9岁那年，爸爸在一次冒险中受了重伤，只交代完了后事就死了。
爸爸说了，让我好好活下去，如果姐姐和妈妈还在世上的话，她们一定会很爱我的，所以我一定要活下去。
由于跟着爸爸四处走，所以我没有固定的住所，我也就只能住在旅馆里。
最开始我做买卖，可是被人举报了。
摆摊需要摆摊许可。
还要交摆摊税。
爸爸没钱的时候会去当冒险者，有钱的时候就去当商人。
我没钱的时候当不了冒险者。
我一个小孩子实在不知道怎么活下去，于是我去捡垃圾。
可是捡垃圾也是不行的，因为垃圾是有主人的。
可我实在饿的不行了。
为了防止别人看我好看，我割掉了我的头发，把自己整的臭烘烘的，身上带着伪装，每次我都很快的就把吃的带走，大家都以为我是个男孩子。
小孩子的声音只要刻意去装一下中性的音，是分不出男女的。

虽然偶尔会人神父看我的眼神怪怪的，原来好看男孩子也不安全。
不过在有秩序的地方，只要多注意，没有人敢明目张胆的直接动手。
加上我经常换地方，晚上在城里是不安全的，如果住在野外的话，只要注意没有人跟踪，就能保证自己的安全。
可惜的是这样的日子没有持续多久。
食物实在太难获取了。
我只能杀了我的朋友。
我以前很喜欢猫，可是在我一次饿的不行的时候，我把那只猫杀了。
明明很喜欢的，有时候也会喂它东西吃，它就像我的朋友一样。
可是我还是杀了它，杀了我的朋友。
后来兽人来了，于是我就跑，趁乱，我偷走了很多东西，想着这样就能活的好好的了。
可是后面我去当铺的时候很凑巧的被原主认出来了。
偷东西是有罪的，我被驱逐了。
再次一无所有。
没事的我一定会活下去的。
可是我失败了。
我把我能想到的一切都用了。
content_en:
My name is Dania Kaberlin, and I was born in a knight's family in the Western Region. Ever since I can remember, I have followed my father on adventures.
It's said to be an adventure, but actually it's to find my mother and sister.
I never met my mother and sister.
Don't know what they are like.
Dad is just a D-level adventurer, but he is also a businessman.
When we were adventuring around, my father would always pay attention to the prices, buy some supplies, and then go to the most expensive places to sell them.
I also learned about being a businessman from my dad.
When I was 9 years old, my father was seriously injured during an adventure, and he died after only explaining the funeral arrangements.
Dad said, let me live well. If my sister and mother are still alive, they will definitely love me very much, so I must live.
Since I moved around with my dad, I had no fixed place to live, so I had to live in hotels.
I started doing business, but someone reported me.
A stall permit is required to set up a stall.
You also have to pay stall tax.
When my father had no money, he would become an adventurer, and when he had money, he would become a businessman.
I can't be a risk taker when I have no money.
As a child, I really didn’t know how to survive, so I went to pick up trash.
But picking up garbage is not an option, because garbage has its owner.
But I'm really hungry.
In order to prevent others from seeing me good-looking, I cut off my hair, made myself smelly, and wore a disguise. Every time I took the food away quickly, everyone thought I was a boy.
As long as the child's voice is deliberately pretending to have a neutral tone, it will not be able to distinguish between male and female.
Although occasionally the priest would look at me strangely, it turns out that good-looking boys are not safe either.
However, in an orderly place, as long as you pay more attention, no one dares to do anything directly and blatantly.
In addition, I often change places, and it is not safe to be in the city at night. If I live in the wild, I can ensure my safety as long as I am careful that no one follows me.
It's a pity that such days did not last long.
Food is just too hard to come by.
I can only kill my friends.
I used to like cats very much, but when I was very hungry, I killed the cat.
I obviously like it very much, and sometimes I feed it food. It is like my friend.
But I still killed it and my friend.
Later, the orcs came, so I ran away. Taking advantage of the chaos, I stole a lot of things, thinking that I could live well this way.
But when I went to the pawn shop later, I happened to be recognized by the original owner.
Stealing was sinful and I was evicted.
Nothing again.
No matter what, I will survive.
But I failed.
I used everything I could think of.
